create_DnaClient: create a DnaClient instance with an API key to connect to the AlphaGenome DNA model server
predict_sequence_DnaClient: predict biological outputs for a raw DNA sequence string using the DnaClient predict_sequence method
predict_interval_DnaClient: predict biological outputs for a genomic interval using the DnaClient predict_interval method
score_variant_DnaClient: score a DNA variant against recommended variant scorers using the DnaClient score_variant method
score_ism_variants_DnaClient: run in silico mutagenesis across an interval and score all single nucleotide variants with DnaClient
